rules.name: Dependency Confusion Attack
rules.description: Detection rules for software supply chain attacks: dependency confusion, typosquatting, compromised packages
rules.query: union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, AzureDiagnostics | where Message contains "supply_chain" or Message contains "" | summarize count(), make_set(SourceIP) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), ActivityDisplayName | where count_ > 3
